title: rcisignal: Quality checks for reverse-correlation data and classification images
description:
An R package consolidating quality assessment of reverse correlation (RC) experiments end-to-end. Input-side diagnostics catch silent data-processing errors before classification image (CI) computation: response coding, response time, response bias, trial counts, duplicate trials, stimulus-pool alignment, and 'rcicr' version compatibility. Output-side analyses quantify CI quality after computation: within-condition reliability via permuted split-half with Spearman-Brown correction and ICC(3,k); between-condition discriminability via Welch pixel-wise t-tests, cluster-based permutation with family-wise error control (Maris & Oostenveld, 2007) and threshold-free cluster enhancement (Smith & Nichols, 2009); per-producer informational value with a trial-count-matched reference distribution that closes a calibration gap in the original 'rcicr' implementation. Supports the standard two-image forced-choice (2IFC) pipeline via 'rcicr' (Dotsch, 2016, 2023) and the Brief-RC pipeline (Schmitz, Rougier, & Yzerbyt, 2024) implemented natively.

Consolidates and supersedes the earlier rcicrdiagnostics (input-side) and rcicrely (output-side) packages.
